new_categories.label: private_regional_terminal_service_ecosystem_readiness
new_categories.memory: A smaller/private/regional terminal can be represented as an ecosystem of delivered services and institutional interfaces rather than as one operator or one physical asset.

new_categories.label: landlord_operator_role_boundary_confidence
new_categories.memory: Confidence about the boundary between landlord/authority responsibilities and operating responsibilities is distinct from physical terminal readiness.

new_categories.label: operator_stevedore_service_boundary_confidence
new_categories.memory: Cargo-operation responsibility may sit across terminal-operator and stevedoring/service layers; the boundary can be uncertain without retaining company or contract facts.

new_categories.label: contractor_provider_dependency_topology_confidence
new_categories.memory: A terminal may depend on multiple external technical, maintenance, inspection or specialist services; abstract dependency topology can be represented without naming providers.

new_categories.label: service_continuity_substitution_depth_confidence
new_categories.memory: Continuity may depend on whether a service role has alternate coverage or substitute providers, distinct from equipment redundancy.

new_categories.label: governance_interface_change_confidence
new_categories.memory: A change in concession, operator, contractor or provider arrangement can alter role boundaries and continuity before physical assets change.

new_categories.label: service_scope_assignment_confidence
new_categories.memory: Operational service scope can be clear, partial or disputed across institutional actors without implying a legal conclusion about responsibility.

new_categories.label: institutional_accountability_interface_confidence
new_categories.memory: The interface through which a degraded service is recognized, escalated and owned is distinct from the technical service state itself.

new_categories.label: shared_resource_dependency_confidence
new_categories.memory: Smaller terminals may rely on shared or externally supplied capabilities; dependency concentration can be represented structurally without naming resources or vendors.

new_categories.label: provider_transition_continuity_confidence
new_categories.memory: Provider or contractor transition can be represented as a continuity state with overlap, gap, partial transfer and restored coverage stages.

new_categories.label: regional_service_network_depth_confidence
new_categories.memory: A regional ecosystem can have shallow or deep substitute service coverage without retaining a provider directory or geography-specific fact.

new_categories.label: institutional_service_margin_confidence
new_categories.memory: A terminal can have enough nominal service coverage yet little margin for absence, substitution or simultaneous demand across institutional roles.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_institutional_service_transition
new_categories.memory: Role assignment, provider availability, handover, verification and release of temporary restrictions can occur at different times.

useful_refinements.label: private_regional_ecosystem_vs_port_governance_P021
useful_refinements.memory: P021 establishes landlord/concession/infrastructure governance; P137 focuses on the operating service ecosystem beneath or across that governance layer.

useful_refinements.label: service_ecosystem_vs_workforce_coverage_P135
useful_refinements.memory: P135 models human workforce coverage; P137 includes organizational and external-provider role topology beyond labor availability.

useful_refinements.label: provider_topology_vs_equipment_oem_lifecycle_P067
useful_refinements.memory: P067 models equipment OEM/service lifecycle; P137 concerns terminal-level multi-provider institutional dependency rather than one equipment support chain.

useful_refinements.label: institutional_interface_vs_stateful_cargo_execution_P014
useful_refinements.memory: P014 models compatible execution states; P137 preserves which institutional service boundary supplies those states without becoming an operating procedure.

duplicates.label: generic_service_availability_degradation_restoration
duplicates.memory: Generic service availability, degradation, restriction, substitution and restoration repeat prior service-state families.

duplicates.label: generic_cross_interface_dependency
duplicates.memory: Generic cross-interface dependency and downstream-effect separation repeat prior terminal/integrated-readiness families.
